How Hirevue solves today’s top challenges
Hiring for healthcare
Healthcare organisations are under more pressure than ever to find, hire, and retain the right talent. Today’s teams face three unique challenges that can make or break patient care and operational success.
Talent and skills scarcity
With a limited pool of qualified candidates—especially for critical frontline roles—finding top performers is a constant struggle.
Workforce retention and turnover
Persistent turnover drains resources, disrupts care, and forces organisations into a costly, never-ending cycle of hiring and training.
Hiring efficiency and cost pressure
Managing high applicant volumes, slow screening processes, and extended time-to-hire increases costs and leaves vital roles unfilled.
Spot top talent, faster
Predict on-the-job success with validated assessments designed for healthcare’s unique demands, so you can confidently identify candidates with the right skills and potential.
Healthcare heroes are known for their long work weeks and non-traditional hours, making traditional hiring processes inefficient. Eliminate the unnecessary stress of calendar tetris and reduce interview rounds with HireVue healthcare recruitment software that includes OnDemand Interviewing and scheduling. Plus, our
OnDemand solutions
give candidates the flexibility to interview when it’s convenient for them which may even be before or after an overnight shift.
Reduce turnover and improve retention
Unlike hospital gowns, our solutions are not one-size-fits all. At Hirevue, we help our healthcare recruitment customers implement a talent engagement strategy specific to your unique challenges and tailored for different areas of hiring. Our platform supports:
Administrative workflows
Clinical hiring pipelines
High-volume caregiver recruitment
Our tools adapt to your workflows and compliance needs for hiring nurses, care coordinators, or physicians. The platform includes nursing and physician recruiting software, and other flexible options to meet the needs of every healthcare team.
Streamline hiring and control costs
Leverage automation, conversational AI, and self-scheduling to eliminate bottlenecks, fill roles quickly, and reduce administrative burden—without sacrificing candidate experience or patient care. Our healthcare recruiting software includes:
Assesments to validate the real skills that drive success and predict performance
Intelligent Interviewing offers AI-driven insight and flexibility needed by all
Self-scheduling tools for live interviews
You can start extending offers in the time it used to take to read resumes. In an industry that relies on the importance of a full-staff and quick decisions, proper healthcare shouldn’t wait on slow hiring.
